title: Created a 3D world model from a Panorama photo using Opus 5.5
author: RageshAntony
selftext:
I was curious whether Claude capable of creating a 3D environment using a panorama image. It worked!.

 Even though it's only 80% accurate, it was able to do it. (Skip to 1:14 for the 3D world.)

`Create an accurate 3D model environment of this panoramic image. Design and construct an exact 3D representation of the rooms in the panorama, including all objects, furniture, and items. Design those using Babylon.js. I should be able to walk around the room, lie on the bed, sit on chairs, etc. Use photorealistic PBR rendering and run it right here`

  
There are some parity issues, like bed direction, chair count, and orientation. But this method feels like using an "Environment Image to 3D" model! 

Previously, I provided a single photo of an outdoor building backyard, and it somehow worked.

 I tried this in Gemini 4 Argon, and it was completely out of its depth. Claude's 3D capabilities are borderline god-tier.
